title: Cassandra connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Apache Cassandra instance's settings (CN2 Task 14): token-range splits read with SELECT JSON and the driver's paging state as the position, and an upsert sink (INSERT … JSON … DEFAULT UNSET) idempotent by primary key. `password` is the name of a secret in the namespace's secret store (D189).

contact_points.description: host[:port] of one or more nodes (port 9042 by default).

password.description: The name of the secret holding the user's password.

consistency.description: The consistency of every read and write.

key.description: Sink: the upsert key, the table's primary key columns in order (partition key, then clustering columns); read from system_schema when omitted, and refused when it differs.

poll_interval_ms.description: Read the table again this long after the last read finished; without it the table is read once.
